ticket: My payment failed and now my account is suspended. When will it be restored?
final_response: I'm sorry to hear your payment failed and your account is suspended. Our system attempts to retry failed payments after 3 days, and then again after 7 days. An account is suspended after two failed attempts, but your data is retained for 30 days. Your account will be restored once a successful payment is processed through these retries.
